rejected.title: growth.dem header tick arithmetic is internally inconsistent (1000 ms → 'apply tick 21')
rejected.reason: FALSE POSITIVE — apply_tick = floor(at_ms × logic_hz / 1000) + 1 = 21 (harness/demo.odin:10-12, the edit fast-path convention). Empirically confirmed: stats stream shows gen→4 at tick 21 (the placed router). The captures use ms/50 because capture is a different mechanism (not a command apply). Header is correct.

rejected.title: start_run resets sibling run-scoped fields but not growth_last_tick
rejected.reason: FALSE POSITIVE — run_init (called first by start_run, every run incl. restarts) does state^ = {} zeroing the whole Run_State incl. growth_last_tick; the later field assignments are app-level config run_init cannot know.

findings.title: 'E31 by construction' comment is false for diagonal direction draws — enforcement rests on the growth_connectable re-check
findings.detail: 4 of 8 compass dirs are diagonal: pos lands dist·√2 from the picked router (up to ≈1.41·span), NOT 'within the connectable radius by construction'. The explicit growth_connectable check is the actual enforcement (E31 holds — verified: goldens, tests, drift all green). Risks: a future 'simplification' trusting the comment could delete the 'redundant' check and break E31; diagonal draws at dist > span/√2 are guaranteed rejects (wasted budget, cardinal placement bias — windows 840+900 of growth.dem exhaust).
findings.recommended_fix: Reword the comment: E31 is enforced by growth_connectable (not construction); optionally bound diagonal dist to ≤ span·5/7 (integer 1/√2) — a golden re-bless if taken.

findings.title: Drift growth_flip spuriously FAILs a blessed growth demo that never spawns (no-junction or cap-before-first-window)
findings.detail: The parser deliberately permits no-junction growth demos ('growth legitimately waits'), and a run capped before tick 120 never opens a window; either way flipped-off replay == manifest byte-for-byte → drift-check reports 'FAIL — gate ACCEPTED a growth-flipped replay' on a valid demo. Latent: no current demo triggers it (growth.dem places a router at tick 21 and runs 1800 ticks).
findings.recommended_fix: Skip the growth_flip class when the blessed run spawned zero growth terminals (compare final node counts), or emit a warning instead of bad+=1.

findings.title: Cross-seed divergence assertion is vacuous w.r.t. growth — seed-99 spawn positions computed then discarded (_ = nc)
findings.detail: ha/hc are full-state per-tick hashes that diverge for ANY two seeds (demand/rng draws differ) regardless of growth; nc (seed-99 growth positions) is collected then discarded. A growth implementation ignoring the rng stream entirely still passes every pin — 'deterministically from the seed' is asserted but not proven by this test.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert divergence on the growth position lists (na vs nc) the test already computes.

findings.title: Era-parse fail-loud guard ('growth on' + era 0) has zero test coverage
findings.detail: The guard is claimed as a swarm fix in the PR body but has no pin: the harness package contains zero @(test) procs and no demo exercises the rejection. Mitigations: no sibling parse guard is tested either (no harness test infra exists), and a silently-accepted era-0 growth demo would surface via drift growth_flip (spuriously) — but that path itself is the latent trap above.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a parse_demo unit test for the era-0 rejection string (and the malformed `growth` variant) — first harness test file, mirroring the core acceptance-pin convention.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 100% (replay byte-identity, same-seed identity, E31 validity, terminals-only, legacy-inert — pinned green, independently re-run by Perkins: 177/177); P1 ≈88% (cross-seed divergence vacuous, parse guard untested); overall ≈82%. P1 in the 80–89% CONCERNS band.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the two P1 gaps above → P1 ≥90% → PASS.

findings.title: Stale doc comment above count_terminals names a nonexistent proc and wrong return shape
findings.detail: Comment documents 'spawned_terminals … Returns their node ids + kinds'; the proc is count_terminals -> int (all live terminals).
findings.recommended_fix: Rewrite the comment to match count_terminals.

findings.title: Sibling separation predicates handle degenerate sep < 1 oppositely (clamp-to-1 vs no-constraint)
findings.detail: node sep clamps sep<1 to 1; pipe sep returns true (no constraint). Unreachable today (GROWTH_MIN_SEP_TILES=3 const) but asymmetric for future callers.
findings.recommended_fix: Handle sep<1 identically in both (or once at growth_pos_valid).

findings.title: Tick 0 is a spawn window that aliases growth_last_tick's zero value (unreachable today: every caller steps from tick 1)
findings.detail: 0 % 120 == 0 and a fresh Run_State has growth_last_tick == 0, so a tick-0 step would be misclassified as a re-step and silently skip the window. Verified unreachable: record_run steps 1..=ticks, harness sim_tick pre-increments from 0, app app.tick pre-increments from 0. Even if stepped, live+replay skip symmetrically (determinism preserved).
findings.recommended_fix: If ever touched again: init growth_last_tick to a non-colliding sentinel (or a separate has-run flag).

findings.title: growth_connectable ignores junction port capacity — a spawn can be beyond every FREE in-span port
findings.detail: Spec-compliant (E31 is defined as span-proximity + separation, not port availability; port limits are 3.5 canon applied at draw). A port-full mesh makes the player place a new router — the core game loop, no hard soft-lock. Observation only.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional depth: prefer candidates near junctions with free ports (ports_available is already a read-only check).

findings.title: 'read-only … structural, same as demand.odin' misstates — growth_plan_pressure receives a mutable ^Topology (discipline, not structure)
findings.detail: demand.odin's purity is structural (it takes NO topology handle); growth takes ^Topology and merely doesn't mutate. Verified growth_plan_pressure only reads. The full ODN-7 snapshot seam is [LATER] per 3.1, so this mirrors the existing pattern — the comment wording overclaims.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the comment ('by discipline; snapshot view is the [LATER] seam hardening').

findings.title: e31_recheck excludes the spawn's own node but not incident pipes — false-fails the E31 audit once any test/demo connects a growth spawn
findings.detail: A pipe whose endpoint is the audited spawn has distance 0 → growth_pipe_sep_ok false → spurious 'violates E31'. Spawn-time validity held; the pipe postdates it. Current tests draw no pipes to growth spawns, so green today.
findings.recommended_fix: In e31_recheck, skip live pipes whose endpoint slot == self_slot (mirror the node-loop exclusion).

findings.title: growth.dem claims 'after the last spawn at t1680' but tick 1800 (the final tick) also spawns
findings.detail: Independently verified via the 5.7 stats stream: gen 19→20 at tick 1800 — a 15th spawn after the last T2 capture (t1760), pinned by T1 only. (Also: windows 840+900 skip — exhaustion branch live in the golden.)
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the comment ('last pre-capture spawn at t1680; a final spawn lands at t1800, pinned by T1').

findings.title: E31 rejection-budget exhaustion branch is not unit-pinned
findings.detail: GROWTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS appears nowhere in growth_test.odin. Mitigating: the branch IS exercised and pinned end-to-end by the growth.dem golden (windows 840+900 deterministically skip — verified in the stats stream), so a regression shifts T1 and fails the gate.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: a crowded-map unit test asserting a deterministic window skip + replay identity.
